execution_strategy.parallelization_strategy: Max 5 concurrent tasks per agent, parallel execution where dependencies allow

risk_register.risk: Docker socket removal breaks container-to-container communication
risk_register.mitigation: Use Docker API over TCP with TLS, or implement DinD (Docker-in-Docker)
risk_register.fallback: Use remote Docker daemon with TLS authentication

risk_register.risk: CSRF protection breaks existing client requests
risk_register.mitigation: Update all frontend API calls to include CSRF token, comprehensive integration testing
risk_register.fallback: Disable CSRF for specific endpoints if needed

risk_register.risk: Celery integration introduces complexity and new failure modes
risk_register.mitigation: Extensive testing, monitoring, graceful degradation to BackgroundTasks if Celery fails
risk_register.fallback: Revert to BackgroundTasks with timeout improvements

risk_register.risk: Circuit breaker triggers falsely during Anthropic API degradation
risk_register.mitigation: Tune threshold and recovery timing, implement half-open state probing
risk_register.fallback: Disable circuit breaker, rely on timeout only

risk_register.risk: Data migration from embedded files to separate collection fails
risk_register.mitigation: Write migration script, test on staging, backup before migration
risk_register.fallback: Rollback to previous schema, keep embedded files

risk_register.risk: Mocking Anthropic API does not reflect real behavior
risk_register.mitigation: Use integration tests with real API in staging, comprehensive mock scenarios

risk_register.risk: Delta-based updates miss edge cases (file renames, deletions)
risk_register.mitigation: Comprehensive testing of file operations, version tracking
risk_register.fallback: Send full file dict for complex operations
